fusions.name: Heat-Seeking Spark
fusions.desc: Flicks a spark into the first enemy in its path for 4 fire damage, with a 25% chance to set it [Burning] for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction on the target, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Fanned Flames
fusions.desc: A beat of your wings fans flame 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 fire damage to everything in it and setting each [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Smoke Veil
fusions.desc: Wraps you in smoke for 5 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Warm-Blood Sense
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
